questions.text: Which organ pumps blood around your body?
questions.explanation: The heart is a muscular pump that circulates blood.

questions.text: How many teeth does a full set of adult human teeth include, wisdom teeth counted?
questions.explanation: A complete adult set has 32 teeth.

questions.text: Which vitamin does your skin produce when exposed to sunlight?
questions.explanation: Sunlight triggers vitamin D synthesis in the skin.

questions.text: What is the largest organ of the human body?
questions.explanation: The skin has the greatest surface area and mass of any organ.

questions.text: Which bone is commonly known as the kneecap?
questions.explanation: The patella protects the front of the knee joint.

questions.text: Which blood cells carry oxygen around the body?
questions.explanation: Haemoglobin in red cells binds oxygen.
Beta cells in the pancreas make insulin.

questions.text: How many chambers does the human heart have?
questions.explanation: Two atria and two ventricles make four chambers.

questions.text: Which coloured part of the eye adjusts the size of the pupil?
questions.explanation: Muscles in the iris widen or narrow the pupil.

questions.text: A severe lack of vitamin C causes which disease?
questions.explanation: Scurvy results from vitamin C deficiency.

questions.text: Which is the smallest bone in the human body?
questions.explanation: The stapes in the middle ear is the smallest bone.

questions.text: Which part of the brain is chiefly responsible for balance and coordination?
questions.explanation: The cerebellum coordinates movement and balance.
Fleming noticed mould killing bacteria in a dish.

questions.text: Which nerve, the longest in the human body, runs from the lower back down each leg?
questions.explanation: The sciatic nerve is the longest and thickest nerve.

questions.text: Which hormone, made by the pineal gland, helps regulate the sleep-wake cycle?
questions.explanation: The pineal gland releases melatonin in darkness.

spares.text: Which organs, protected by the rib cage, fill with air when you breathe in?
spares.explanation: The lungs inflate as you inhale.

spares.text: What is the name of the main artery that carries blood out of the heart?
spares.explanation: The aorta carries oxygenated blood from the left ventricle.

spares.text: Which vitamin is essential for normal blood clotting?
spares.explanation: Vitamin K is needed to make clotting factors.
